static_findings.conclusion: Prior simulation physically adds sigma=.002 Gaussian noise and uses nv=sigma^2=4e-6. Natural-image E3 adds no noise; nv=1e-5 only specifies the regularized GP inverse. sqrt(nv)=.003162 is not injected noise. Do not reinterpret sigma=.002 as only numerical regularization.
